brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Portwise, the freight visibility platform in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: dependable and calm, for operations teams who look at it all day; serious enough for enterprise procurement. No globes, ships, containers, trucks or arrows. Web app, sales decks and LinkedIn.

claim.notes: Üç yönün hepsi iki sketch incelemesinde eleştirmenden 'none' aldı ve reddedildi; kapıyı geçen konsept olmadığından finalize, export ve galeri çalıştırılmadı; ad için önceki kullanım riski var, sicil taraması yapılamadı.

concepts.title: Harbour Gate
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 two plain rectangles, generic; s2 square split on the diagonal (cut device); s3 Pac-Man/C disc with a bite; s4 P with an open bowl (initial plus cut). All struck. Different move: a form that is not a split letter or shape.

concepts.title: Pillar P
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 hamburger/menu with a purple pill; s2 blocky P with a bite; s3 P from pill+disc, generic; s4 plain P with a loop. All are the initial with a cut/overlap or a UI icon. Different move: a non-letter form.

concepts.title: Range
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 bell-curve chart icon; s2 wifi/signal icon; s3 copy/duplicate UI icon; s4 sliced dome, sunrise cliche with a cut. All struck. Different move: drop the distribution metaphor, find a non-chart, non-letter form.
